title: Salami Salad
blurb: The dressing gets shaken together before any chopping starts, so the fennel and red onion have time to mellow in it while the rest of the salad comes together.

ingredients.note: gem romaine, or 1 heart romaine, chopped
Genoa or fennel salami, sliced into strips
small bulb, quartered, cored and thinly sliced

ingredients.qtyText: drained, plus drop peppers or peppadews, for topping

steps: For the dressing: combine the granulated garlic, granulated onion, oregano, dried parsley, sugar and red pepper flakes in a jar or container. Add the vinegar, Dijon and olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and shake to combine.

Chop the lettuce into a bowl. Halve the salami, slice into 1/4-inch strips, and add to the bowl. Quarter, core and thinly slice the fennel; thinly slice the red onion. Add both to the salad along with the pickled cherry peppers.
Toss with the dressing to serve.
